response.sql: WITH scored AS (SELECT s.instownpct, AVG(s.instownpct) OVER () AS overall_avg, AVG(s.instownpct) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS mix_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership, AVG(instownpct / NULLIF(mix_avg, 0)) AS avg_ownership_to_mix_avg_ratio, AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_ownership FROM scored WHERE instownpct > overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: Each matched sentiment record counts as one observation; a transaction with multiple sentiment records can contribute multiple ownership values.

alternatives.interpretation: Count each transaction once, using the average of its nonmissing linked ownership values.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_transaction AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.instownpct) AS instownpct FROM transactionrecord AS t JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), scored AS (SELECT instownpct, AVG(instownpct) OVER () AS overall_avg, AVG(instownpct) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_avg FROM per_transaction) SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership, AVG(instownpct / NULLIF(mix_avg, 0)) AS avg_ownership_to_mix_avg_ratio, AVG(instownpct - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_ownership FROM scored WHERE instownpct > overall_avg
